sentence_en: This stone is smooth, but that stone is rough.

sentence_en: Before the interview he is nervous, but afterwards he is calm.

sentence_en: Today it is sunny, but tomorrow it is cloudy.

sentence_en: This stool is sturdy, but that stool is wobbly.

sentence_en: Yesterday the man was polite, but today he is rude.

sentence_en: This chair is comfortable, but that chair is uncomfortable.

sentence_en: Today the dog is good, but yesterday it was naughty.

sentence_en: Today the hall looks festive, but yesterday it was bare.

sentence_en: At first the woman waited patiently, but now she is impatient.

sentence_en: Here the water is pure, but there it is polluted.

sentence_en: This morning the desk was neatly tidied, but now it is messy.

sentence_en: After exercise the man is supple, but in the morning he is stiff.
